title: Naveena Saraswathi Sabatham
desc: Lord Shiva hijacks four friends' bachelor party with the intention of recruiting them. As a result, they wake up on a deserted island with no memory of how they got there.

title: Yashoda
desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

title: Saba Nayagan
desc: Arrested for public nuisance, Saba thinks of ways to get himself freed. Soon, in an attempt to coax the police, Saba narrates his love complicated story.

title: Santharppavaathi
desc: Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.

title: Pisasu
desc: Upon witnessing the death of a young girl in an accident, Siddharth, a violinist, begins to feel a supernatural presence in his house. The mystery begins to unfold when he meets the girl's father.

title: Padayottam
desc: A comical group of gangsters who have never been feared embark on a serious journey to gain respect from their fellow citizens.

title: Naan Local
desc: Babu, a carefree graduate, falls in love with Keerthy, his classmate, and pursues a relationship with her. However, her father doesn't approve of their union and wants her to marry a successful man.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Mundasupatti
desc: Gopi, a professional photographer, goes to a remote village along with his friend. However, the villagers are suspicious about their cameras.

title: Seedan
desc: Mano is in love with Maha, a maid, in his grandmother's house, but lacks the courage to confess to his mother. After his marriage is fixed, a distraught Maha vents her anger in Lord Murugan's temple.
